reviews.comment: She is super sweet and explains things very thoroughly. If you come up to her after class with questions, she always answers with a smile and is super kind. She even learns her students names. I enjoyed her class and I learned a lot.

Foran is amazing and really understanding of your situation if anything happens to where you are struggling in the class. I really recommend office hours if you need extra help. Her lectures can be boring sometimes but they're definitely better than most math lectures because she's funny.

Dr. Foran explains things thoroughly and the WHY behind math, which as a non-math person really helps. She's also a very personal professor. There's two or three short homeworks a week, but the exams really determine your grade.

If you did not take MATH135, you will struggle. She does not explain things very well and is mean when you speak to her. We have a lot of homework assignments that aren't graded for months and are given with 1 or 2 days notice. The tests are pretty easy if you took 135 but my classmates next to me struggled deeply. Try to take someone else.
Please do not listen to the review below. Was probably Foran herself commenting....

Ignore all of the other reviews, Dr. Foran was one of the best professors I ever had. Her lectures were clear and she rarely ever took attendance. She has office hours twice a week for 2 hours and they were my saving grace. I literally did all of my homework there and she would answer any questions. Study the hw for the exam and you will do well.

She was overall a good teacher and her lectures were very clear. Pay attention in class and complete and understand the homework and the class shouldn't be bad. Do the test reviews and math week-in-reviews for studying, they are very helpful.

Do not take her for math 365! Had 9 missing grades including an exam up until the final. Never responded to emails, always acted rushed like you were bothering her. Condescending and expects you to already know the content. Very vague and unhelpful. No curve, extra credit or rounding.

There are weekly quizzes in this class, and if you don't do well on them your grade will suffer. There weren't any extra credit opportunities until the final. The professor was really sweet and she took the time during her office hour to explain where I went wrong in my steps and gave me tips on how to avoid making the same mistakes.

Professor Foran is probably one of the best math professors I've ever had. She explains topics on a conceptual level that is easy to understand which makes the course a breeze. If you have her as a professor enjoy this class because there isn't many professors that teach like her!

Dr. Foran is very knowledgeable. The problem is, she just doesn't do a great job passing that knowledge onto us. She simply works out problems without explaining hardly anything, so if you don't have prior knowledge or misunderstand her at first, good luck. She also never responds to emails; I once went an entire month without a response.

Looked online before taking her class and saw the high reviews. However, actually being in the class was completely different. The professor was the most uninterested and the least passionate professor I have ever had. She never responds to emails and just copies off of notes every lecture. You could learn better off of youtube or by yourself.
If you want to cry yourself to sleep every night definitely take her! In all honesty she's a very nice person but she should not teach Math 365.

Dr.Foran is a very nice and she isn't a bad teacher, however her class feels pretty much impossible. There has only been 1 exam where the average is higher than a 60 and she offers no extra credit. Attendance is required but she only took it like 3 times, and exams are worth 70%ish of you grade! She isn't the worst but you probably will struggle.

Sets you up for failure. She seems like she may be a good professor for her other classes but do not take her for 365. Does not prepare you, will not post any study material before exams and gives you problems you've never seen before on graded assignments, especially tests. If you take her for 365... Pray for your GPA.

Honestly, if you take this class with her, good luck! She takes forever to grade anything, she gives random homeoworks the day before an exam. She did not even grade exam three til two days before the final. So unorganized it insane. She nice but does not teach she tells.

If you struggle with math I would not recommend. She does not curve/ offer extra credit. 4 examsno review. Will teach new topics the class before an exam. Randomly assigned homework or major assignments. Taught material like you already have a clear understanding of it and struggles to explain the why behind it or break it down. Nice person though

She's a pretty funny professor and is very helpful. Recitation is half weekly quizzes and python labs. Lab is all lecture and exams, with 3-4 homework assignments a week. Overall not too hard if you use your resources and put effort into learning the material.

Cares about math, but seems very indifferent about actually teaching. Lots of practice problems, but not a lot of explanation of concepts. Uses lecture sheets that have concepts, but skips over them in class, so you either need a tablet or a physical copy to follow along with the lectures. Uses iClicker for participation. No curves.

if i could have her teach me all of my calculuses i would. she is super sweet and knows her stuff. homework actually helps if you do it and if you don't it won't tank your grade. tests are hard though so beware

She is a very nice lady but she is beyond disorganized which is difficult for a math class. Unresponsive and does not respond to emails. She will give homework at random times with no heads up with the due date ranging from the next day to a week later. Also does not provide helpful resources before exams and usually has the wrong thing posted.

Foran is a very outspoken and extroverted professor. She loves participation, though it doesn't count for extra credit, she gives a lot of feedback on questions in lectures, and she is very transparent on any issues or heads ups through her emails.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: W prof for realz, completely changed my perspective on math in general cause she teaches in a way that's useful to the average human being who is not a genius wish she taught calc 2 as well though
I liked Dr. Foran. Shes really nice, I understood her lectures and made it really clear to understand.
Made me enjoy going to lectures. She was easy to understand and enjoyable to listen to. 100% would take her again.

I don't know why she gets so many good reviews. She's a terrible professor who hardly ever responded to emails. I would ask her questions and she would never respond either. Most of the questions in office hours were also shrugged off. DO NOT TAKE HER

She was the best professor I could have asked for. She explained everything wonderfully and made it easy to understand. She also made her class fun and made me want to go to her class. Would 100% recommend that you take her class.

Great Professor, especially for math. She gives good lectures and the notes are recorded live on a class notebook in Teams/OneNote. But most of all she is great for questions before, during, after, and outside of class. Super helpful and personable, easily can bump up your grade by a letter just with her teaching style.
she is an amazing Professor! She actually made me want to get up and go to class in the morning to learn math. She is funny, and never dismisses questions you have.

Dr. Foran posts all her notes online after class; however, there are no Zoom recordings, so attendance is important if you want to hear her explain each concept. There were three night exams, and each was very difficult if you didn't study frequently. Easy to pass the class if you do all the Python labs and stay attentive for the quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Foran makes lectures easy to understand. The homework and exams are challenging but manageable with diligent practice. I found unstuck study and the professor's office hours very helpful.

TAKE HER!!! Foran is super funny and caring. She would answer any question and help clear up any confusion. She is super approachable and doesn't make you feel bad for not understanding something. This was the only class I enjoyed going too.

very sweet and approachable professor. she was always patient with questions and organizes notes very well for you to use later on. a fairly difficult course so as much of a grat professor she is, getting a good grade is in your hands

Easy class, lecture heavy with homework after each lesson. A few major assignments here and there. 3 exams with extra credit available on them. Slow grader. Spontaneous IClickers for attendance purposes worth 1 point. Very nice professor who is always available after class or during office hours. Show up to class and you won't fail.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the better math profs, but she is exam heavy. Please go to offices hours you you need help it is the only reason I passed, she is super helpful. Study up for the exams and quizzes though, they are harder than the homework.

Dr. Foran was a great professor for the 2 semesters I had her. I had her for Math 150 & 151. Her lectures were very helpful to me and the blank notes she provides and fills out during class helped me a lot as well. I would definitely take another of her classes again.

Dr. Foran is very caring. Her lectures are quite easy to understand. The test and quizzes can be difficult, and make up a large portion of your grade. Have come to the conclusion it is pretty hard to get an A in a math class after taking her twice. She seemed very accessible outside and in class willing to discuss anything we seemed to struggle on.

The GOAT of all math profs. Does a fantastic job at explaining the problems and she's very accessible outside of class. Her exams aren't too difficult but they do require you to study for them. Homework's are easy and can be completed fairly quickly. Overall the best prof I've ever had.

She may be the best math teacher I've ever had. Explanations are concise, and the lectures are exactly what you need for the homework. The tests are a huge part of the grade, but that is the Math departments doing not her. If you have the choice, always pick her!

Professor Foran was an amazing professor. Her lectures were engaging and she cares about her students understanding the material well. She is phenomenal in her explanations and the tests are very manageable. No real issues in this class with her or her teaching besides the content of pre calc that can get difficult. Know unit circle!

The best prof at the school tbh. Had fun and engaging lectures, was extremely accessible by email, graded nicely, and had all the information needed for success posted. Had tons of review which came in clutch during finals season. Her office hours were nice too and she really took the time to engage with the students that came. GOAT

She's a good professor. There would be times that she would cover things quick, but I think that's just because of the nature of the course. She broke topics down in way that was easier to understand, and she never minded answering questions.
Lectures go really fast and I didn't love how she explained things, very up to you and your work ethic to do well in this class.

She made lectures extremely digestible. Notes were also super neat and worked out on OneNote. Exams are common, so study past exams. Very nice person and patient during office hours when explaining the material. Would definitely recommend.

Great lectures, tried to make the content as easy to understand as possible. Unfortunate she had lectures at HELD, which the room can make anyone fall asleep regardless of class. HW never took more than two hours, TA I had was excellent at his job and made learning sympy bearable. Exams were difficult, but if you did your work you should do fine.

She makes the the tests way harder than the quizzes/homework/notes. I feel like she deliberately tries to make you fail the class. Disregard all of these reviews they are lying to you and want you to fail.

I had her for MATH 366 and you could tell she was not expecting to teach this class. Nothing was ever graded on time and she barely ever gave feedback when you finally got your grade back. I am not great at math in general, but her disorganization made the class extremely stressful. She does give extra credit quizzes though.

Her lectures are perhaps some of the ones I enjoy the most, despite my disdain for anything math.

Each unit she does has a section of homework which takes about an hour, but by God, you better seriously study for her exams if you want to get anything better than a C or low B
She is a decent professor, but test + quizzes are worth over 80% of the total grade. The lectures are long but she gives a "brain break."

Dr Foran is an amazing prof, she makes the class very easy to understand and her lectures/presentations are based around the homework, so as long as you attend lectures, you will succeed in her class. Also utilize her office hours, and be prepared to practice, she gives plenty of time between exams and is lenient.

An excellent lecturer, takes her time explaining problems and answering any and all questions before and during the lecture. Homework took a while but was beneficial, and tests were difficult but with adequate time spent studying I had no problems scoring well on them.

I took her this spring for Calculus, and she was great! She posts both her blank and finished notes, but I highly recommend going to her lectures and following along (she also uses iClicker). The only thing I disliked is that there were some problems on the homework that weren't covered in class, but use your resources and you'll be fine.

Dr.Foran was absolutely amazing. She will make you look forward to coming to class and truly does care about you and anything you have going on. Dr.Foran is understanding, but is also stern on deadlines but gives plenty of grace. There is a lot of homework, but it is doable and not terrible

Dr. Foran is by far the best math prof I have ever had. She genuinely cares about students and about your performance in the class. Despite the class being a tough one that makes many students drop, her lecture style makes the material so easy to understand.

10/10 recommend, especially for engineering students.

Dr. Foran loves math so much, she's able to spread her love for math over to the students. She is such an amazing professor and she really wants the best for her students! She teaches so so well and she is able to make little jokes that help you remember formulas and stuff in math. She is honestly so amazing, take Dr. Foran if you can!
I took another teachers math151, and I couldn't understand her to save my life. Dr. Foran saved my Calc grade. Amazing teacher that actually makes an effort to learn everyone's name.

This is the second semester in a row with Dr. Foran and man am I lucky. She teaches math that honestly just makes sense. I have probably never had a better math teacher in my life. The concepts of CALC1 are hard and the quizzes and labs assigned honestly shot down my grade much lower than any of the exams have. All in all great teacher for all math
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Foran for both MATH 150 and 151, and she is the best! She does her best to make lectures entertaining while also doing her job as a professor. She truly cares about the success of her students.

Dr. Foran is so understanding. MATH 151 is the first class I had ever struggled in and she understood my circumstances and helped me make a plan to get through it. She's a good lecturer and her office hours are a godsend. In a class of over 300, she will make a point to learn your name. Definitely recommend.

Dr. Foran was an incredible person and lecturer. The only heavy thing about this class is the homework, especially the python labs but that is not her fault. She even added extra office hours from her own time just for those of us struggling with python. Take her! you wont regret it.
She is one of the best professors at A&M if you can take her for any math class I highly recommend you do. She is very good at teaching and makes math so much easier than other professors.

Prof Foran is amazing! I had her 8am section for Math 150 this semester and she truly does an awesome job. She is able to explain concepts in such a clear and understandable way. I completely recommend her and I am taking her again for 151!
Dr. Foran is everything you would ever want in a math professor! Really enjoyed her class and can't for M151 with her next semester!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr Foran is literally the best! Her lectures are super easy to follow, and she can teach well. Definitely recommend her!

Great professor, Calc is a hard subject but she was very good at teaching. However the year I took math 151 they decided to make the exams way harder than in previous years which failed a lot of people in her class. However, she is a good professor so I would recommend taking her.
i love her!

Dr. Foran is the absolute BEST Math professor at A&M. I definitely recommend taking her class as she makes the course material easy to understand and breaks down complicated concepts into simple steps. She is also really funny and I love to hear her stories.

Professor Foran was a lifesaver! I had attempted math 151 the semester prior and had a sucky prof. I had to drop it and retake it this past semester with Foran and she helped me a ton! Lectures are important, so attend them. She looks for the class for feedback, like if we look tired, she'll encourage us with an activity, or reiterate the topic.

One of the best professors you will ever have EVER. I have never bothered to write a review for any professor on RMP but it's been 6 months since I last had Dr. Foran and no professor in ANY of my classes has been able to match her exceptional lectures, engaging teaching style, and energetic personality. She made coming to lecture an absolute joy.

She is an amazing prof. Super engaging lectures that are easy to understand. She is super accessible outside of class through office hours and week in reviews. Exams are just common exams but the final is incredibly difficult (because she writes it, not common exam) so be prepared for that. Overall I HIGHLY recommend her class, great at teaching
Dr. Foran is an amazing professor, do not hesitate to take 151 with her.

I absolutely loved Dr. Foran! Math 151 was a little bit of a struggle for me, only because I had never taken Calculus before I attended TAMU. Dr. Foran is an amazing professor who genuinely wants all of her students to succeed and knows many of her students by name. The class itself is very exam heavy, but study hard and you should be just fine.

Had Professor Foran for MATH 150 + 151. Best professor I have had by far. Lectures are well paced, organized, and relevant. Test material was finished a week before exams to give students time to study. She knew most kids by name. Don't be afraid to go to office hours she is super helpful with any questions and actually cares about you succeeding.

Dr. Foran is awesome at relating the material back to the real world and putting it in terms that will make you actually understand. She has amazing lectures and as long as you attend and pay attention, grasping the material should come easily.

Dr. Foran is by far the best mathematics instructor I've ever had. She is extremely caring, and respects each and every one of her students. She is a phenomenal math instructor, and an amazing person all around. I highly suggest her for math 150 and 151.

Dr. Foran is an AMAZING math teacher who makes the class fun, and she breaks down lecture material making it easy to understand. There are common exams in this course, but she prepared us well for each one and I definitely recommend taking her for MATH 151.

Dr. Foran is by far the best MATH 150/151 professor. She actually tries super hard to help everyone out. 

She's super caring and likes to have fun during the lecture.
Great professor. She genuinely cares for her students' success. The class is fairly easy, especially if you took calculus in high school. Weekly HW assignments.

Dr. Foran is awesome. She knows what she's doing and is very organized. She doesn't make the class more complicated then it should be. Homework, quizzes, and tests are really all there is to it. She always cracks jokes and gives students time to take a break during class.

Take Dr. Foran if you can, the lectures are helpful, well paced, and will keep you interested. Only issue with this class is how exam heavy it is, but that's just how the course is for everyone. Go to office hours, it's very helpful, and just spam common exams before taking exams.
Great professor, most of the grade is in the labs and exams. She provides a lot of practice questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Foran was honestly such a great professor and extremely interesting in lecture. I loved her explanations and she would give good feedback when you reached out for help.

Professor Foran is incredible. Such a kind and caring professor, but also funny. She teaches the material very clearly and the homework and tests match what she teaches in class. The lectures are entertaining, and she really cares about every student understanding the material, not just passing the class.

Has easy to follow lectures with premade notes where you just follow along. Asking questions for further clarification with her is very easy and most of the time I was able to get out of math 151 around 10 minutes early with her wrapping up class early as well as her giving short breaks during class whenever everyone seems burnt out.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took her classes in the fall and she was amazing. Her lectures were very well planned out and are directly related to the homework, quizzes, and tests. Additionally, she responds quickly to any questions and is available after class. The only issue was learning the math lab for her class taught by the TA, but again he was a good teacher. 10/10
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Funny, caring, lectures aren't painful, eager to answer questions. I would take Dr. Foran again in a heartbeat.

She was a great person, really chill and funny But I could not pass the class to save my life! I didnt think that it was fair that there were other professors that were more lenient! But take her she good! Maybe Im just not that bright!

Foran is a really cool and nice professor. As for the class MATH151 is 80% exam grades. Luckily your final exam replaces your lowest exam grade. Also every past exam is posted with solutions so it's a really easy to pass class regardless of professor. You don't need to show up to any lectures, just the quizzes and labs.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While I was admittedly ashamed of entering my freshman year taking Math150 rather than 151 or 171, Dr. Foran is an incredible professor and I'm glad I got the experience. While I already had the essentials of this course, her lectures solidified all concepts. Only complaint is that sometimes her answers to student questions aren't what they asked.
Great professor and easy to understand.
She was awesome, if you have the chance to have her as your professor, then do it.
python group labs, weekly homework, 3 exams and a final. dr foran is super nice and her lectures are pretty good. if your ta is nice youll prob avg a 100 on the labs and quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Foran; I would take her class again in a heartbeat. She is likely the best MATH 151 prof, her class averages on the common exams are often higher than all the other profs. She makes herself extremely accessible outside of class, and if you introduce yourself to her she will make it a priority to remember your name. She is a great prof!!

Dr. Foran was literally my favorite prof. Easily the best math 151 professor there is. If you do the homework and practice tests you should get an A. Her office hours are super helpful too if you get stuck
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I strongly suggest that if you can't register for Foran, wait until the next semester to take math. She hands down the best Math 151 prof at A&M. From the way that she teaches the material to how she is as a person-- she is amazing! Dr. Foran validates every question asked by her students and makes herself available frequently! She's also FUNNY.

The best prof I've ever had. Attend office hours and ESPECIALLY week in review. This is not an easy class but she is benevolent in how she grades and how she assigns work. Will round high Bs to As. If you don't get her for a prof, find someone who has her office hours and she will help you even if you're not in her class (but don't be rude or lazy)
This is a fairly easy class. The Cengage HW is easy but is so hard to use. The exams are not bad. If have some idea about what's going on in class and do the past exams, you'll be totally fine.

Legitimately the best prof that I have ever met. Always accessible by email and OFFICE HOURS ARE YOUR BEST FRIEND please go and be friends with her. She is so easy to work with, and you can genuinely tell that she cares about you. Week in review is also an amazing resource, utilize it!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This amazing woman is the best teacher I've ever had hands down in my whole academic career. I had her for Math 150 and 151 and we are now very good friends. I spent so much time in her office asking questions and she was always there to help. ALWAYS! Tests can suck (but math does) but she gives you everything you need to know. MAKE ROOM FOR HER!!!

Dr. Foran made it worthwhile for me to schlep myself out of bed at 8am MWF across campus to Kyle Field. She is an incredible prof who knows the names of any students who have ever spoken to her as far as I can tell. She is willing to sacrifice personal time to take care of her students and her students respect her because she clearly respects them.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super good. I had her for 150 and 151 and she is by far the best math teacher I've had. She cares a lot and it very knowledgeable.
Overall great professor, expect to have fun and learn math. I hope to have her for MATH 151 too!!

she is the best and made math fun. she makes math extremely easy and understandable. everyone in my class loved her! as long as you show up to class and listen to the lectures it should be an easy A. I also went to her week in reviews to grasp a better understanding of the concepts. This class shouldn't be hard for anyone as long as you take her!
Dr. Foran is such a great professor. I wish I could take her again. I would highly recommend her for Math 150. She always gives great feedback and is very accessible.

BEST math teacher I have ever had. lectures were very easy to understand. bonus points were awarded frequently, but you still need to do your work. REARRANGE your schedule for her class. funny in lectures, office hours, and MLC review. go to lecture, participate in recitation, do your homework, you will pass.

Dr. Foran is easily the best math 151 professor there is. She made learning calculus feel much easier and fluid than calculus should be. Study the past common exams and you will get an A. Dr. Foran genuinely cares for her students and wants everyone to learn. I promise you will miss out by not taking Foran!!! Also, sit in the front of class!!!!

TAKE HER! She made calculus easier than it could be. She drops some assignments and has less work outside of class than other profs. Go to her office hours, she is nice and fun to talk to. She is a sweetheart and I absolutely loved taking her class

She was an overall amazing professor. There's a lot of homework but its easy. She hosts a week-in-review but I never went because I didn't need to. She gave us small breaks during lectures when she could tell we were burning out. She responds to emails fairly quickly. 100/10 would recommend.

Dr. Foran is the best! If you take her for 150 or 151 you'll definitely pass. She's funny, caring, and teaches math in a way that everyone seems to understand it. Answers all questions well & does her best to make sure you understand. The best math teacher I've ever had. She's so worth it if you can take her, rearrange your schedule so you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Literally the best professor I've ever had. If you don't take her class and you have the option, then you're making a mistake. She's a shining example of what teachers should be. Loved her.
Great Teacher, felt comfortable asking questions.

TAKE DR FORAN OMG BEST PROF EVER AT TEXAS A&M!!!!! Super compassionate caring and an all around AMAZING TEACHER. Best math teacher Ive ever had Im so serious LISTEN TO ME!! You have to do the work and try but she is always there to help with anything that doesnt make sense. I sat with her in office hours 3 days a week shes amazing!!! LOVE ALI!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Serious the best PROF ever! Made math super easy to understand. Class is not mandatory because she posts the notes online after but I would encourage you to go because it helps with understanding the concepts. Labs, quizzes, and hw are not worth much but could bring you to the next letter grade. Final test grade replaces your lowest test grade.

I took Dr. Foran for MATH 151 and I can't emphasize enough how amazing a professor she is. Lectures are great because she explains concepts and works problems in a way that students can easily understand. Dr. Foran genuinely cares about all her students and has a funny sense of humor! I learned a lot in her class and i would highly recommend!
Worth building your schedule around her class. Trust me.

Dr. Foran was the sweetest professor. Her tests were always straight forward, and her study guides/ homework questions really prepared you for the questions asked on the exams. Her notes were the best because you could print them out ahead of time, and she didn't go too quickly through them. You'll pass if you do all the homework and go to class!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's the best and I feel comfortable asking her questions because she is so nice! She's also hilarious and really wants everyone to succeed! Definitely show up to lecture.

You would think.. hmm that person made a C so she must not be a good prof... WRONG. Shes the absolute best prof you can get and actually cares for you. If you struggle with math like I do, she is the prof you need! She is so caring and kind. Always available to reach out to. Super quick responses. TAKE HER!!!
Dr. Foran is literally the best! She a professor who cares about you as a student, as well as a human being. I love her class because she takes the time to make sure that her students are okay.

I took Dr. Foran for MATH 150 and Math 151, she is an incredible professor and genuinely cares for her students. I loved her class and I hate math. She is very relatable and wants her students to understand the concepts. Would 100% take her for all of my math classes.
Absolutely loved Foran. Genuinely cares about students and an amazing prof overall. Her lectures are informative and helpful. Would definitely recommend taking her if you can.

Dr. Foran is honestly one of the best math professors ive had. She cares about her students, has great lectures, will stop the class for a bit if she realizes some ones not following along, knew my name (and i only talked to her probably 3 times). Yeah if u get the chance you should take her!

Dr. Foran is my favorite teacher that I have had in college thus far. She made her lectures easy to understand and fun to listen to because of her sense of humor. Ive never been great at math but I got a 100 on the final (which also replaced my 3rd test grade) and ended with an A. She gives lots of examples and does exam reviews Great prof!

Dr. Foran is the perfect math teacher for every kind of student. Her lectures are extremely educational, and she is very receptive to in-class questions. She adjusts the class pace to best fit the students, provides tons of examples, offers helpful study guides, and hosts ample office/review sessions. Her tests are fair and she offers corrections.

I only went to class for the first week and after that only for the exams and still got an A. Overall pretty nice professor, very accessible outside of class and helpful. She gave exams back for corrections and you would get some credit for the questions. I would recommend taking her class 100%.

She is a great professor. She loves to teach and her lectures are very clear but get repetitive... but it's math so that is good. You don't even need to show up to class of you feel comfortable learning it on your own and the homework is very easy. She gives a test review as well which is very helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Foran is one of the best professors I have ever had! She is very clear and concise in her lectures and is VERY helpful when it comes to explaining anything you do not understand. She is terrific and will help your transition into college level math so much easier!
Dr. Foran is so funny and sweet! As long as you go to her class you'll be fine. Lots of table group work which makes it soooo much easier. No textbooks or anything. She is awesome!

Dr. Foran is a great professor. She really cares about her students and always answers questions and guides you through them. The class is an easy A as long as you go to class as there are participation grades.
